name: cursor

argv: Read the task in {prompt_file} and carry it out. End with your final answer.

notes: Print mode takes the prompt as an argument, so the harness passes a prompt file. --force lets the agent edit files without confirmation. Sign-in or CURSOR_API_KEY is handled by the CLI. Upstream reports print mode hanging in some versions; the provider timeout ends a hung run. The generic command name `agent` can belong to another tool: check the detected path.
